agreements: Gearbox v1 verified baseline remains preserved; this review does not mutate formal A/B/C state or claim C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime are zero Experience.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational progress only under the v2.1 contract and must never promote P_base, Trust, Identity, Personality or Governance.
v2.1 strict-bool guards for secretary_signal_fresh, authority_conflict and direct event_independently_verified are valid local hardening but do not establish provenance authority.
verified_progress_density is currently reason-only and must remain observational/non-authoritative.
P_base, Identity, Personality and Governance remain non-writable from v2.1.

disagreements.finding: ExperienceLedgerResult returns only verified_experience, operational_progress, duplicate_events and ignored_events. It carries no accepted event identities, canonical evidence hashes, verifier receipt hashes, acceptance-record hash or manifest/root hash. Therefore even after direct event-field credit is removed, the decision layer cannot prove which exact accepted evidence produced a credit total, cannot bind credit to a durable acceptance record, and cannot distinguish a legitimate aggregate from a caller-reconstructed aggregate with the same numbers.
disagreements.required_change: Replace aggregate-only authority handoff with an immutable AcceptedExperienceBatchReceipt or equivalent manifest containing acceptance_record_hash/root, canonical accepted event/evidence identities, verifier/C receipt bindings, runtime/install/workspace identity, policy version and monotonic acceptance cursor. Gearbox decision projection may consume totals only when they are derived from and bound to that exact receipt; naked counters are analytics only and must be non-authoritative.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict remain caller declarations without replay-resistant source, timestamp/TTL, policy and installation/runtime identity binding.
disagreements.required_change: Use typed SecretarySignalEnvelope and AuthorityDecisionEnvelope bound to exact source, scope, freshness, policy and installation/runtime identity.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not project or enforce the actual fresh authority decision.
disagreements.required_change: Consume exact trusted authority state/gear constraints. Missing, stale, revoked or cross-scope authority evidence must fail closed.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum support, observation window, uncertainty or independent enter/exit hysteresis.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release behavior.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can lower gear_shift_rate while delaying necessary safe upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure throughput or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require matched performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; fewer shifts alone is not improvement.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still requires only event kind plus a boolean; no exact evidence hash, verifier identity or trusted C/independent-verifier receipt is required.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable evidence identity and trusted verifier receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only inside one aggregate invocation; same evidence under new IDs, cross-run replay, rollback/poll replay and same-ID rebinding can still be re-credited.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry with exact replay=no-op, same-evidence/new-ID=lineage duplicate and same-ID/different-binding=IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields, bypassing aggregate_experience_events and any future durable-ledger repair.
disagreements.required_change: Both credit classes must come from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: Gearbox v2 publicly mixes DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND into experience_candidate_delta, allowing legacy consumers to misclassify operational progress as Experience-labelled credit.
disagreements.required_change: Make verified Experience and operational progress distinct authoritative fields at the shared intake; legacy mixed credit must be research-only/non-authoritative.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 executes int(selected[1:]) although inherited v1/v2 can legally return N or R, so standby/rollback paths can raise ValueError.
disagreements.required_change: Handle N/R before G-gear parsing; N returns standby and R returns rollback immediately with zero credit and no anti-thrash interference.

disagreements.finding: current_gear is caller-supplied while controlling v2 hysteresis and v2.1 anti-thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive current_gear from canonical monotonic runtime/shift state bound to runtime/install identity and policy hash.

disagreements.finding: verification_stage is caller-supplied; self-reporting C_VERIFIED can remove the unverified G4 cap without exact C evidence.
disagreements.required_change: Derive verification_stage only from trusted verifier/acceptance receipts bound to exact mission, step, scope, evidence, freshness and revocation state.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 verified credits and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No executable matched paired-baseline protocol currently establishes speedup; commit count, wake count or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with uncertainty, full assigned-workload coverage and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: Caller-forged secretary freshness, authority conflict, current gear or verification stage invalidates causal routing comparisons.
Small-n shift-rate estimates have extreme variance; a single >=0.50 threshold can false-trigger or chatter without independent release hysteresis.
Anti-thrash can reduce apparent gear_shift_rate while worsening cycle latency, verified closure throughput or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if later wired from policy-created progress back into upshift decisions.
Transient event identity plus direct decision-path credit can inflate longitudinal verified/operational totals.

Aggregate-only ledger outputs are not proof-carrying: equal totals can arise from different event/evidence sets, making audit, replay resistance and causal attribution impossible without an acceptance manifest/root.

A legacy mixed experience_candidate_delta field can create classification leakage: operational progress may be counted as Experience in downstream longitudinal metrics even when v2.1 itself separates the fields.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
durable_progress_per_wake is denominator-sensitive; verified_closure_per_hour is exposure/censoring-sensitive; fixed treatment order and completed-only analysis add carryover and survivorship bias.
proposed_tests: GB21-LEDGER-RECEIPT-BINDING-056: two different accepted event/evidence sets engineered to yield identical verified/operational totals must produce different acceptance roots/receipt hashes; naked equal counters must not authorize decision credit.
GB21-LEDGER-RECEIPT-REPLAY-057: exact accepted batch receipt replay is a no-op; stale/revoked/cross-installation/cross-policy batch receipts are rejected and cannot reproduce credit.

GB21-LEDGER-DECISION-PROJECTION-058: select_gear_v2_1 may emit nonzero verified/operational delta only when bound to the exact accepted batch/record receipt; missing or mismatched receipt yields zero credit.
GB21-FRESHNESS-FORGE-001 + AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: stale secretary cannot affect gear and trusted authority decision is projected exactly.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 + SHIFT-SMALL-N-004 + ANTI-THRASH-CHATTER-040 + RELEASE-041: canonical shift ledger, adequate support, uncertainty and bounded enter/exit behavior are required.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1 alone has zero routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.

GB21-EVENT-ID-TYPE-049 + EVENT-ID-STRUCTURAL-REPLAY-051 + CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 + ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 + POLL-REPLAY-020 + EVENT-REBIND-021: durable exactly-once and identity-conflict semantics survive type variation, restart, rollback and polling.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier/C receipt gets zero credit.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 + OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: receipt-less repeated decision calls create zero additional credit.
GB21-NR-STATE-043 + ROLLBACK-STATE-044: N/R safety states never enter numeric gear parsing and are never blocked by anti-thrash.
GB21-LEGACY-OPERATIONAL-SEMANTICS-054 + LEGACY-CONSUMER-MISCLASSIFICATION-055: operational events cannot enter authoritative Experience-labelled counters through legacy v2 APIs.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 + WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030 + TIME-WINDOW-FREEZE-032 + ORDER-CROSSOVER-036 + ITT-WORKLOAD-COVERAGE-038: speedup requires matched workload, frozen denominator/exposure policy, crossover/order control, full assigned-workload coverage and uncertainty/non-regression.

release_condition.authority_and_freshness: Secretary freshness and authority conflict must be derived from exact trusted, replay-resistant envelopes; fresh authority decision must be projected, not merely secretary-neutralized.
release_condition.anti_thrash: recent_shift_rate_ratio must be canonical-ledger-derived with preregistered denominator/window/minimum support/uncertainty and independent enter/exit hysteresis; safety downshift immediate; safe upshift performance non-regression demonstrated.
release_condition.experience_authority: One durable rollback-resistant acceptance registry is the sole source of verified Experience and operational progress. Every nonzero decision credit is bound to immutable accepted event/evidence/verifier receipt and a batch/record acceptance root; aggregate counters without proof are analytics only.
release_condition.operational_only: DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only and cannot affect verified Experience, P_base, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance or formal authority.
release_condition.credit_weights: 5/4/3/1 remain heuristic/TEST_REQUIRED and cannot be interpreted as capability units or promotion thresholds.
release_condition.speedup: No speedup claim until sealed matched-workload paired/crossover baseline establishes improvement on durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour and cycle_completion_latency with stable/lower rework_ratio and recovery_latency, frozen denominator/exposure/censoring/order/coverage policies, uncertainty reporting and verification/risk non-regression.
release_condition.formal: Existing A->B->C required for adoption; this W02 review cannot declare PASS or mutate formal state/code.
